title: 1.1 What people look like
unit_outcome: Describe people and family, say what people do every day and how often, and ask about other people's habits in Spanish.
goal: Describe how people look: Luis es alto. Ana tiene el pelo largo. Es un hombre mayor.
grammar_function: ser + alto/bajo/mayor/joven (agreeing); tener + el pelo largo / barba; Es un/una + noun + adjective.
speaking_outcome: Describe how people look: Luis es alto. Ana tiene el pelo largo. Es un hombre mayor.
